d:
Cemetery老师的作品对人物体态和精神恶堕的描绘算是独树一帜的，而且触手与身体的交互也很有冲击力，可惜长久以来翻译该老师的作品太少。本人可惜也对日语不通，很多时候看该老师作品也是看汉字脑部人物对话与心理状态。目前使用AI进行了一下翻译工作，感觉在能充分理解女角色恶堕的过程后，作品的冲击力更上一层楼。因此打着独乐乐不如众乐乐的心态将把AI翻译版本上传到公众，翻译与贴字效果应该不如传统手艺，但希望各位能喜欢，并且也希望各位多多支持老师的作品。

Cemetery’s work stands out for its unique depiction of character physique and the psychological descent into depravity; the interaction between tentacles and the body is particularly striking. Unfortunately, very few of this artist's works have been translated over the years. As I do not speak Japanese myself, I often have to rely on the kanji to mentally fill in the dialogue and internal states of the characters. Recently, I used AI to translate some of the material, and I found that fully grasping the nuances of the female characters' corruption significantly heightened the impact of the work. Believing that such enjoyment is best shared, I decided to upload these AI-translated versions for everyone. While the translation and typesetting quality may not match that of traditional manual work, I hope you enjoy them and continue to support the artist's creations.
